Title:                         Zoning Reclassification Map No. 5-H at 1617 N Honore St •
                               App No. 22125
Committee(s) Assignment:       Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                                ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO;


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 5-H in the area bounded by

A line 168 feet north of and parallel to West North Avenue; the alley next east of and parallel to North
Honore Street; A line 192 feet north of and parallel to West North Avenue; and North Honore Street.

to those of a RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.




Common Address of Property: 1617 North Honore Street
